steps.name: runtime-contract-foundation
steps.summary: API/worker runtime 공통 계약으로 env config, worker loop options, health/dispatch result, composition root Protocol, framework-neutral API request/response DTO와 import boundary 테스트를 추가했다.

steps.name: auth-api-session-runtime
steps.summary: MetaMask login challenge/session use case, framework-neutral auth API handler, injected PostgreSQL auth repositories/schema, structured auth error mapping과 fake 기반 runtime 테스트를 추가했다.

steps.name: order-api-checkout-start
steps.summary: 고객 주문 생성 application/API와 injected PostgreSQL order repositories/schema를 추가하고 OrderCreatedEvent outbox payload로 checkout 시작 계약을 검증했다.
